articleTitle: An IoT-Cloud Based Smart Healthcare Monitoring System Using Container Based Virtual Environment in Edge Device
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The rising thought of the Internet of Things (IoT) is quickly discovering its way all through our modern life, aiming to enhance the quality of life by associating numerous smart devices, technologies, and applications. Overall, the IoT would allow for the automation of everything around us. Currently researchers have found that there is a potential application of IoT in to the healthcare related industry. In this paper, we presented a model that automates the problem of patients vital data collection, delivery, and processing with the help of edge device (Raspberry pi) and Docker container. Thus assisting the doctor to diagnose and observe medical issues wherever the patient is.

articleTitle: Solar Charger for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Our dependence on fossil fuels is drastically reduced by the combined use of solar energy and Electric Vehicle (EV) charging. In this paper, a solar charger for electric vehicle is designed and developed. A dc-dc boost converter is employed to boost the solar panel voltage to station battery voltage and Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) is done to optimize the output from solar panel. A buck converter is used to step down the station battery voltage to electric vehicle battery voltage. The constant voltage and constant current methods of charging are used to charge the vehicle battery. A complete simulation study of the system is carried out in the SIMULINK environment of MATLAB.

articleTitle: Smart Mirror- Digital Magazine for University Implemented Using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The design of smart mirror using Raspberry Pi. This may look like the regular mirror but the difference is it displays weather, temperature, time, and web application for college. The smart mirror is implemented using peripherals like raspberry pi, LED monitor covered with a two-way acrylic sheet. The microcontroller can connect to the Internet and can retrieve data from the internet which displays weather report of the particular location. This describes how smart mirror is built using the raspberry pi as hardware.

articleTitle: Solar Panel Automated Cleaning (SPAC) System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Solar energy is the most abundant source of renewable energy. Constant soling and wind storm further reduce the efficiency. Therefore it is essential to have regular and proper cleaning of panel. In most of the parts the cleaning is done manually. This type of cleaning is not uniform and it may cause health issues to the workers. This can be solved by fully automated permanent setup solar panel cleaning system with/without water. It uses soft yet powerful nylon brushes to clean the panels and also has two squeegee on either sides of brush to wipe out water. The system can be retrofitted directly on to the panels in solar power plant, commercial, residential sectors. In this system, the water can be reused, vibration free, multiple row cleaning. The project intends to increase the efficiency of solar panel by removing all kinds of dust particles. In future it can be provided as a permanent cleaning robot at time of installation along with panel frame, dust detection sensor, temperature sensor and camera surveillance, which is centrally connected.

articleTitle: Density Based Traffic Control System Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In this paper, a novel real-time traffic control system which can easily keep traffic in control using image processing techniques is presented. In this method, a webcam is used in each stage of the traffic light in order to take pictures of the roads where traffic is bound to occur. Count of vehicles in these images is calculated using image processing tools in Matlab and different timings are allocated according to the count along with a green signal for vehicles to pass. In the proposed prototype, the green and red signals are represented using LEDs and the decrementing timer for the green signal is represented by a seven segment display.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Brain Tumor in MRI Images Using CNN with Edge Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Brain tumor is a collection of mutated cells in brain. Gliomas are the most aggressive brain tumor. Gliomas generally growby diffuse infiltration in to the inner portion of the brain and these are therefore often not directly visible on the brain surface. The efficient treatment planning and detection is the way to improve the condition of oncological patients. The established technique is to detect the gliomas by the method of MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging). Manual segmentation takes reasonable time since large number of data generated by MRI have to be processed. For accurate segmentation, a novel completely automatic and reliable segmentation based on CNN is proposed. The 3×3 kernels provide a positive effect against over fitting. In pre-processing step, intensity normalization, which is not normally used in Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), is applied in this work. For applications like keyhole and the Nano robotic surgery it is beneficial to have correct edges of the particular tumor. Canny edge detection and edge detection using wavelet transform methods were performed on the image. Using PCNN method Image enhancement is done. The edge detection with image enhancement will lead to a wide variety of surgical applications in medical field.

articleTitle: Continuous Speech Recognition System for Malayalam Language Using Kaldi
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: An automatic speech recognition system aims to enable communication between human and computer. Here a continuous Malayalam speech recognition system is developed and realized using Kaldi toolkit. For building the proposed system, MFCC features and its transformations such as LDA and MLLT are extracted from Malayalam speech sentences. Then, the system has been trained to estimate the HMM parameters for speech sound units. Performance of both monophone and triphone models using bi-gram language model is compared in terms of word error rate(WER). A substantial drop in WER is obtained for triphone models.

articleTitle: Optimization Technique Based Fuzzy Logic Controller for MPPT of Solar PV System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Sunlight based Photovoltaic (PV) is a vital sustainable power hotspot for mankind. The productivity of the PV framework is subject to the different ecological elements like irradiance, temperature, tidy, daylight's ghastly thickness. By utilizing Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) strategies, we can build the effectiveness of sun oriented photovoltaic framework. Numerous strategies have been proposed to build the energy of PV module in the diverse condition factors. In the present work Genetic algorithm based Fuzzy Logic MPPT has been utilized and reproduction comes about are contrasted with Perturb and Observe (P&O) MPPT utilizing MATLAB. A Solar Photovoltaic Generation System incorporated a sun powered module, a Fuzzy Logic Controller (FLC), a Boost converter (venture up converter) and a resistive load. Fuzzy Logic Controller use for controlling the switch plot for boost Converter. Viability and achievability of the FLC based MPPT system is appeared by the recreation result.

articleTitle: Emotion Recognition from Physiological Signals Using Time-Frequency Analysis Methods
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Emotions play an important role in the psychology and physiology of the human. It originates from the day to day experiences, people they interact with and the environment they deal with. In the current day of technological development, emotion recognition has got great attention, since it can contribute to the Human-machine interaction and for complete automation. Emotion recognition from physiological signals can help people with impairments in social interaction, communication and developmental disorders. This work tries to detect the human emotions from physiological signal, Electrocardiogram (ECG) using time-frequency analysis methods. It also provides a comparison of the performance of different time frequency methods of feature extraction. Discrete wavelet transform and Hilbert Haung transform are the time frequency methods used. For comparison two classification techniques Support Vector Machine and K-Nearest Neighbhour are also used. the emotions considered are happy and sad. Database was obtained from DECAF, a database of all physiological signals of different emotions.

articleTitle: Pill Care-The Smart Pill Box with Remind, Authenticate and Confirmation Function
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Central to most aspects of medicine from primary care to specialized treatments, prescription drugs have become a major component of health systems worldwide. Owing to their psychoactive effects, these drugs are often taken in ways not intended by the doctor or by someone other than the person for whom it had been prescribed. patients often forget to take their prescribed medications or consume it out of the schedule recommended by the doctor. There are also instances of teenagers stealing drugs such as opiates, CNS depressants and stimulants from their friends and family. Our goal for this project is to build a system around prescription drugs that helps authenticate a patient's access of such medication based on their identity and prescribed schedule, and also facilitates the pharmacist or doctor to monitor this consumption.

articleTitle: Face Recognition and Weapon Detection from Very Low Resolution Image
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In this paper, we are implementing a convolutional neural network for face recognition. We preprocess the pictures by utilizing channels. Haar cascade is utilized to distinguish face and weapon. Convolutional neural system is utilized upon the distinguished pictures to prepare the system for perceiving the pictures. CNN utilizes less pre processing when contrasted with other image classification algorithm. CNN utilizes neurons which naturally learns based on weights and bias. For any new faces discovered we will catch the arrangement of pictures of the new face and prepare them under a name. With the goal that new faces likewise can be trained and perceived utilizing CNN.

articleTitle: A Framework for Analysis of Road Accidents
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The road accident data analysis use data mining and machine learning techniques, focusing on identifying factors that affect the severity of an accident. There are a variety of reasons that contribute to accidents. Some of them are internal to the driver but many are external. For example, adverse weather conditions like fog, rainfall or snowfall cause partial visibility and it may become difficult as well as risky to drive on such roads. It is expected that the findings from this paper would help civic authorities to take proactive actions on likely crash prone weather and traffic conditions.

articleTitle: Optimal Sitting and Sizing of Renewable Energy Resources for Power Loss Reduction in Radial Distribution Systems Using Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In worldwide, the day to day usage of electric power is increasing expeditiously which results in the increase of both real and reactive losses and reduction in voltage in a distribution network. The integration of distributed or dispersed generation (DG) to the distribution network greatly decreases the power loss and improves the voltage level. In order to extract maximum advantages from the DG, it should be placed at an optimum location with optimum size. In this paper, the performance of different DG technologies has been analyzed. Combined loss sensitivity (CLS) is used to identify the optimal location and whale optimization is used for the optimal size of DG. In order to test and validate the performance of proposed technique two standard test cases, IEEE 33-bus test system and 69-bus test systems have been considered.

articleTitle: Path Planning of an Autonomous Quadcopter Based Delivery System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper presents a novel offline path planning algorithm for the quadcopter based delivery system. For any quadcopter based system, time of execution needs to be minimized as it affects the system performance. This proposed algorithm is a combination of sampling based Bidirectional RRT algorithm and improved Artificial potential field (APF) algorithm, so that the former is made more goal oriented. Algorithm rely on the knowledge of the environment from sensors, to plan a path efficiently with reduced execution time. Improved APF limits the search space to a smaller section of the environment in turn reducing the execution time. Validation of the algorithm is done using ROS TUM simulator AR Drone in presence of obstacles. A proportional position and altitude controller are used to track the path which is planned using proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Automated Accident Alert
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The rapid growth of technology and infrastructure has made our lives easier. The advent of technology has also increased the traffic hazards and the road accidents take place frequently which causes huge loss of life and property because of the poor emergency facilities. Our paper will provide an optimum solution to this drawback. According to the paper when an accident occurs the sensor will detect the values and send to the controller. Once the threshold crosses it will send the alert message to control station or rescue team via ZigBee module. So the rescue team(ambulance vehicle) can immediately trace the location necessary action will be taken. If the person inside the vehicle is not injured or no threats to any one's life, there is provision to terminate the alert message by pressing a switch. So that the valuable time of the rescue team can be saved. This paper proposes a system that ensures immediate medical service to a person who meets with the accident without an human aid and within a minimum time.

articleTitle: Robust Control of a Ball and Beam System Through Sliding Mode Controller
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper presents the design of an optimal control strategy for a 2 degree of freedom standard laboratory system - Ball and Beam. The system is an open loop and non-linear system, which is inherently unstable. The control of The Ball and Beam system is very important in the aviation and space fields because of its similarity to the control of aircraft during the flight, landing and turbulent. Since real experiments are not possible in these areas, using Ball and Beam systems in the control laboratories has become necessary. This paper proposes a robsust controller design via sliding mode control approach. A Sliding mode controller (SMC) is designed and implemented with an objective to control the ball position on the beam by varying the angular position of beam. We design a discontinuous sliding mode controller which overcomes the problems associated with the set of singular states. The modelling and simulation of the SMC strategy for controlling the system is carried out on MATLAB SIMULINK platform. The SMC strategy is very effective in stabilizing the system. A comparative analysis is also presented by varying the parameter (mass of ball) of system in simulation.

articleTitle: An Image Encryption Technique Using Logistic Map and Z-Order Curve
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Image encryption is an important field in multimedia security. This paper proposes a new encryption technique for gray scale images using Logistic map and Z-order curve. The key stream generated for this algorithm not only depends on the chaotic map but the original image. In this technique the original image is scrambled using Z-order curve. Then this scrambled image is encrypted using the random matrix generated using the logistic map. Experimental results and security analysis shows that the proposed method has high security and can resist various types of attacks.

articleTitle: Real Time Facial Expression Recognition Based on Deep Convolutional Spatial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Facial Expression Recognition plays a great significance in the field Artificial Intelligence. In, this paper we proposed deep convolution spatial neural network (DCSNN) for extracting the deep features of images after that trained and test our system by using the datasets and then apply it in a live webcam. The datasets such as FERC-2013 on Kaggle facial expression recognition combination and Jaffe face datasets are used here. After, training and testing we will validate the accuracy and then applying the pre-trained model on a live webcam and find the expressions of the human.

articleTitle: A Genetically Optimized Method for Weight Updating in Fuzzy Cognitive Maps
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Fuzzy Cognitive Map (FCM) offers a flexible modeling environment for handling both uncertainty and cognitive mapping. This recurrent structure combines the generalization capacity of fuzzy and learning capacity of neural networks for decision making. In traditional FCM, the weight matrix showing relationship between concepts in a particular domain was developed by experts. Correctly computed weight matrix will shows the intelligent behavior of a system by letting the relevant concepts to interact each other there by producing the required output using an inference rule. In situations where no experts are available, learning from existing data is the only choice. Weight matrix learning can be formulated as a heuristic search problem that finds suitable weight combinations. Instead of simply generating a random matrix from available historic data, various similarity measures were combined together with the optimization capacity of genetic algorithms for producing the weight matrix. The proposed method focus on reducing the difference between obtained response and actual response in minimum number of iterations.

articleTitle: A Grid Connected Hybrid PV/Fuel Cell/Battery Using Five Level PWM Inverter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In the recent times the utilization of renewable energy sources has gained many advantages in today's generation and among them is the PV cells which is attracting research scholars on day to day basis. In this paper the mathematical modelling of Photovoltaic cell (PV) using MATLAB/SIMULINK tool is done. Maximum power point tracking (MPPT) is used for increasing the efficiency of the used PV. Due to the change in solar irradiance from day to night various problem arises. This problem is solved by integrating PV arrays with the Solid Oxide Fuel Cell (SOFC) and battery thus forming a standalone hybrid PV-SOFC-Battery generation system. Certain disadvantage of the PV system is that the output voltage is low so we need to boost its voltage using boost converter so that five level inverter would convert it into alternating form. The whole of the hybrid standalone system is connected to grid. The modelling of PV, SOFC and the five level inverter are done using SIMULINK in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network Based Simile Classification System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Figurative Language is a kind of language that express ideas with a meaning different from its actual literal interpretation. Social media makes use of a wide range of figurative languages. Among them Simile, Sarcasm, Irony and humor are mostly used. Simile essentially compares two different things and often occur in tweets. People make use of indirect interpretations to express their views. Thus arises the need of detecting other figurative languages occurrence in similes. For proper understanding of text, occurrences of sarcasm, irony and humor in similes is necessary. Current approaches mainly focus on detection of one or two figurative languages at once. This paper proposes classification of different figurative languages at once using deep learning concept such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and machine learning concepts like Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, K-nearest neighbor (KNN), Gaussian Naive Bayes (GNB) classifier. Also, compared the performance of different classification models.

articleTitle: A Secure Cloud Computing Authentication Using Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Cloud Computing is becoming an envisioned paradigm shift in latest IT scenarios. Cloud Computing provides user a centralized virtual environment without any investment of active physical infrastructure. Clients can store data in cloud and run any applications over internet. Cloud computing is a massive pool of services which can provide clients a system as well as a platform, small to big hardware components, virtual operating system based infrastructure and some system management software. But all data transmission in cloud computing now may come in possibilities of threats. So data security in cloud computing is still at big risk in present IT scenario. Although various type of existing cryptographic algorithms for cloud security are performing but still now all these type of algorithms can be partly or fully broken by anyone. So we need a comparatively strong enhanced security algorithm for reliable cloud platform. In our paper we have shown the use of elliptic curve cryptography algorithm in cloud security and we have proposed as a better security model which serves with minimal computational power in cloud computing than other public key cryptosystem like RSA cryptosystem.

articleTitle: Wireless Power Transmission Incorporating Solar Energy as Source for Motoring Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Wired technology is the conventional way of connecting elements in a circuit, but it required further sophistication and innovation. In recent times, Wireless Power Transmission has begun to emerge as a solution to deliver energy to devices at remote distances and places not easily accessible by wires and cables. This method involves the transferring of electrical energy wirelessly from a transmitter to a receiver, placed at some distance from each other. The idea used here, is to send energy over some range, using a renewable energy source, such as solar energy, without using wire connections. PV panels are used in this case, as they play a pivotal role by being the source of renewable energy, unlike the other contemporary nonrenewable energy sources. The PV panels convert sunlight into electrical energy by Photovoltaic Effect. The voltage obtained is then given to the transmitter, which transmits energy in the form of EM waves, with the help of one coil at the transmission end and another at the receiving end. The receiver decodes the transmitted wave to its original form, generating the same voltage as observed at the transmitting end. This whole set-up is arranged in a panel which can be kept on rooftops and terraces, giving transmission and reception range over a wide span of area, which may include a living room or a work-space.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Flow Using Distributed Generation and Conservation Voltage Reduction Techniques for Micro-Grids
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Voltage control is critical in power systems operation and control. With the increase in using distributed generation DG, it becomes essential to ensure that voltage stability is main-tained. This work studies using DG and conservation voltage reduction CVR for improving voltage profile, reducing generation cost, and power loss. The size and location of the DG was optimized based on the voltage profile criterion. The buse's voltages were reduced to the lower band to decrease generation cost and total power loss. Optimal Power flow using PSO algorithm was implemented to investigate the power system voltage profile, 30 bus IEEE systems is used in this work. The results showed that accompanying DG with CVR can reduce generation cost and power loss by 13.14 and17.22.

articleTitle: An Anti-Islanding Technique for Grid-Connected DG and Multi DG System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Islanding is a major problem that is related to a grid connected distribution generator. During islanding the distribution generator gets disconnected from the grid while still being energized. It should be detected as fast as possible in order to prevent the distribution generator from getting damaged or to ensure the safety of the personnel working. The islanding detection makes use of system parameter to detect islanding at the time of occurrence. In this paper a passive islanding detection method based on ripple content of voltage at the point of common coupling is being used to differentiate between islanding and non-islanding conditions. A threshold level is set upon the ripple content of voltage at the point of common coupling and islanding is detected whenever the threshold level is exceeded for some certain period of time. This method effectively distinguishes the islanding condition from other non-islanding condition and detects the islanding condition efficiently. The working of this method is being ensured by simulating a variety of islanding and non-islanding condition. No non-detection zone was shown by this method and islanding conditions were detected within 150ms of the allowed delay time. Theoretical analysis and simulation results are presented to validate the proposed method.

articleTitle: Smart System Monitoring Agricultural Land Using Iot
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This work depicts the real work in agribusiness field which is finished by an android computerized gadget which fills in according to the charge of the agriculturist (in particular to his local dialect) utilizing android application which is introduced on the rancher's telephone. For planning Android computerized framework, we furnish legitimate correspondence with the rancher, Data focus and the mechanized gadgets that are available in the agrarian field. With reference to correspondence utilizing GCM or JSON we will make the Android computerized gadget work and send back the affirmation. We likewise give auto mode where the computerized gadgets and the server farm convey and trade the information between them. It investigations the information got and sends back the summons as indicated by the dissected information. It additionally stores the data about every last activity for some time later. Also, a PIR sensor is associated with identify a human and creature if its recognized the signal will get enacted and picture of the human or creature will go to the agriculturist mail and temperature sensor esteem and mugginess sensor esteem will be passed to the rancher mail. The application we grow additionally have the component of making inquiries or questions which makes it agriculturist benevolent. Through this we will coordinate the diverse utilization of agribusiness field which not occurred in past advances and research.

articleTitle: Simulation of Single Phase Cascaded H-Bridge Multilevel Inverters & THD Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper imparts an outline on numerous multi-level H-Bridge topologies and discusses their appropriateness in single-phase systems. The Alternating voltage with structure of staircase waveform can be generated from various levels of voltages in Multilevel Inverter. This is similar to sinusoidal waveform with low harmonic distortion. This type of Multilevel Inverters reduces filter requirements. The need of several sources on the DC side of the converter makes multilevel technology promising for renewable energy applications. Several industries and Power sector are using Cascaded H-bridge for modern technical development. It has sever-al benefits over two-level inverter so they are preferred in renewable energy applications. This paper presents the study of three level, five level and seven level cascaded H-bridge inverter in single phase system. Power quality issue of harmonics is discussed for each lev-el. Simulation has been done for various levels of voltages acquiring control signals by with Phase disposition technique. Matlab is used to simulate all three configuration and their results are compared.

articleTitle: An Andriod Application for Smart Parking With Efficient Space Management
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Paying for parking is a waste of time and an inconvenient procedure. To solve this problem we introduce our system “An android application for smart parking with efficient space management” which offers full automation of paying for parking. Our solution will change the life of every driver. This will not waste their time anymore searching for a parking meter because the parking meter will find them. They will not have to pay a parking ticket again since they get the nearest place for parking using our system and pay parking fees for the place. There is also a module, the user can give their place for parking and they get rent for the parking slot, if the place is in congested areas then the amount of rent will also increase. Security is another one, we provide security for each vehicle that registered for parking. Efficient space management in the parking area is also important. That will help the application's proper working and customer satisfaction. The user first needs to register or create an account using his android phone and application. This registration will save on our server. When the time for parking the vehicle number scanned with a camera and compare with the registered number in sever, if they match then the gate automatically opens, else don't. Only after the timeout and or timeout call the vehicle can safely get out of the parking area. The cameras installed in the parking area to capture photos of the vehicle at every entering an exciting time and send them to the server. The time will also be recorded.

articleTitle: IoT Enabled Robots with QR Code Based Localization
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Robots are sophisticated form of IoT devices as they are smart devices that scrutinize sensor data from multiple sources and observe events to decide the best procedural actions to supervise and manoeuvre objects in the physical world. In this paper, localization of the robot is addressed by QR code Detection and path optimization is accomplished by Dijkstras algorithm. The robot can navigate automatically in its environment with sensors and shortest path is computed whenever heading measurements are updated with QR code landmark recognition. The proposed approach highly reduces computational burden and deployment complexity as it reflects the use of artificial intelligence to self-correct its course when required. An Encrypted communication channel is established over wireless local area network using SSHv2 protocol to transfer or receive sensor data(or commands) making it an IoT enabled Robot.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Ultra Capacitor Based Regenerative Braking System for a DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Electrical vehicle with its high efficiency, noiseless operation and effective elimination of toxic exhaust gases have gained attention this decade. In earlier times, when conventional vehicles were used a large amount of energy was wasted due to the friction between the wheels and brake pads. In regenerative braking instead of wasting the energy produced during braking, the excess energy is stored and reused with the help of ultra capacitor based arrangement. Hence regenerative braking plays a vital role in electric vehicles. The present study is focused on ultra capacitor based regenerative braking system and it consists of synchronous buck-boost converter, ultra capacitor, battery, DC motor and a flywheel. With a synchronous buck-boost converter the kinetic energy stored in the vehicle can be converted into electrical energy and hence can be reused. In the present work regenerative braking along with the energy restoration are being discussed. During the motoring mode the battery drives the motor and this energy is stored in a flywheel. During regenerative braking, the DC motor act as a generator and the saved energy is fed to the ultra capacitor through a current controlled operation. The variation of motor speed, ultra capacitor current and voltage during regenerative braking operations was discussed.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Management of Wind Farm Using STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper describes active power control and reactive power management in a grid connected variable speed wind electric conversion system (WECS) using a STATCOM. The chosen variable speed WECS consists of two wind turbines with a DFIG and a SCIG. The stator winding of both the machines is connected to the 60 Hz supply and variable pitch turbine drives the rotor of the machines. As wind speed exceeds nominal wind speed power output of the turbine is limited to its rated value. Reactive power demand of induction generator is accomplished by capacitor banks connected at generator terminal and STATCOM. STATCOM is set at a 3% droop setting. The WECS scheme is simulated using system models in MATLAB-Simulink and the performance is studied.

articleTitle: Classification of Outer Retinal Layers Based on KNN-Classifier
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Eyes are the organs of the visual system. The eyes are affected by eye diseases causing loss of vision. Retinitis Pigmentosa is a genetic condition which is passed down to families and it varies from person to person. Segmentation (Automatic) of external retinal layers is challenging because of the resolution of the human eye. This paper proposes a technique to classify the external retinal layers by means of KNN. It helps doctors to plan on further treatment. To segment the external layers in the retina by applying different preprocessing steps. To detect the region of interest(outer retina) the pre-processing step is performed. Second, few Framework parameters of the outer retina are calculated by fitting the candidate models. To select the Framework supported by the data Framework resolution technique is required by model selection. The detected layers are assigned by the labels (layer identification). Finally, classification by (KNN) to decide whether or not the eye's is in normal or in abnormal condition.

articleTitle: Soft Computing Using GWO (Grey Wolf Optimization) for the Performance Improvement of High Speed Brushless DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This papers aims at the design of Buck-Boost converter fed BLDC (Brushless DC) motor drive. Many industrial applications brushless DC motor (BLDC) is widely used because of their high torque, high efficiency and low volume. Brushless DC motor performances are compared for different control strategies in this paper. The main core of this work compare the performance of the conventional PI controller, FUZZY logic controller, hybrid (PI+FUZZY) and Grey wolf optimization (GWO) algorithm. Compared to the conventional techniques GWO has the ability to satisfied control characteristics and it is easy for computing. For comparison, across the supply mains Total, Crest Factor (CF), Harmonic Distortion (THD) and Power Factor (PF), the controller performances are maximum peak overshoot (M<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>), settling time (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub>), rise time (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</sub>) and steady state error (Ess) and motor parameters are speed and torque are to be analyzed simultaneously. The modeling, control and simulation of the BLDC motor have been done using the software packages MATLAB/SIMULINK result verifies that the GWO gives the better control performance than the conventional controllers.

articleTitle: On-Board Integreted Charger for Electric Vehicle Based on Split Three Phase Insuction Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper describes on-board battery charger for electric vehicle based on split three-phase induction motor. Fast battery charger is obligatory to improve the charging rate of an electric vehicle. Electric vehicle will be attractive then and then only when charging time of EV is in permissible limit. Typical on-board charger for electric vehicle limits the high power because of hardware and cost concern. In on-board battery charger reduction of weight, volume, space, and cost can be obtained by integrating charger component with traction circuitry. Traction component of EV not engaged during charging time so it is possible to use them in charging circuit. Thus while charging, the stator winding of traction motor used as the filter inductor at the front end of AC to DC converter. Here split three-phase induction motor having an inbuilt capability to cancel out rotating magnetic field at the time of charging, by rearranging the stator winding of the induction motor. The same motor can be use for charging and traction process. The input filter in high power rectifier keeps line current distortion within the allowable limit. Simulation results for the proposed concept are provided for comparison of AC to DC converter with and without filter inductor and charging of battery from AC grid.

articleTitle: The Unique Id's you Can't Delete: Browser Fingerprints
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In today's jungle of interconnected networks the number of people using the internet are well on the rise. A browser fingerprint is information gathered about a remote computer for the aim of identification. This paper brings forth an untried method of fingerprinting, which engulfs system and browser features and runs in the background without the user's cognizance. A windows service that fingerprints the browser and track user actions i.e. sites visited by the user is proposed. The fingerprint is generated using Murmur hash which is considered to be less prone to collision.

articleTitle: Automated Vehicle Identity Verification and Tracking
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In the transportation field, there are so many paper documents to be maintained for each and every vehicle. Every vehicle owner needs to carry all the updated documents of a vehicle with them while driving on public roadways. But it is very difficult for a person to carry all the vehicle documents such as RC book, insurance details, and more along with them always. There is also a problem of theft of those documents or the documents may be lost or damaged due to weather conditions or as time passes. If the driver forgets to take any one of those documents, he will need to give heavy fines. Through this project “Automated Vehicle Identity Verification & Tracking”, all the documents of a vehicle can be accessed electronically using an RFID chip embedded in the vehicle. The chip contains an identification number to uniquely identify each vehicle, and with the help of a special reading device, using the identification number documents of the vehicle can be retrieved. The reader is connected to a secure server which stores all the vehicle documents and fetches all the information about the vehicle like RC book, owner details, smoke test details, and more and displays on the reader's display. The user will also get a notification about the expiration of each of the documents to their contact number. The chip can also be used to track stolen vehicles by the authorities.

articleTitle: Android Application for Car Wash Services
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In this era, the most affordable way to reach out the customers are by using web app and mobile app. There are millions of mobile applications being launched every day. A mobile app is any application that uses an android OS for accessing the Application. The application can be as simple as a message board. In this paper we are introducing an application called `We-cleanse' that brings life back to your vehicle with services like car wash and mechanical support.

articleTitle: Human-Computer Interaction System Using 2D and 3D Hand Gestures
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Hand gesture interaction has been the trending technology for human-computer interaction (HCI). Frequently a number of research works are carried out in this area to expedite and contrive interaction with computers. In this paper, we propose a real-time human-computer interaction system (HCI) using two different hand gestures - hand pointing and clenched fist gesture. We propose a single camera hand gesture estimation algorithm for hand gesture tracking in 2D space from a distance and are mapped to the screen coordinates. Moreover, we also propose orthogonal cameras to estimate hand gestures in 3D space from a distance and is mapped to the screen coordinates.

articleTitle: Simulation and Performance Analysis of Security Issue Using Floodlight Controller in Software Defined Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Software Defined Networking (SDN), is an archetype that decouples the management plane and information plane. Data plane is employed to only forward the information and management plane is used to make a decision however information ought to be forwarded. Open networking Foundation (ONF) may be a cluster that's employed in the development of SDN. For interfacing of management plane and data plane in SDN needs some protocol. One such protocol is OpenFlow. The primary normal interface designed for SDN is OpenFlow. It provides superior, dominant granular traffic across multiple vendor's network devices. As the network infrastructure of a company grows, it's very troublesome to manage and such networks from a centralized system like portable computer through programs. As an attempt during this paper we have a tendency to adopt the SDN technology to manage the networks programmatically. In this paper we have a tendency to address the problems for providing security to the network from DDoS mitigation. In this paper for DDoS mitigation we tend to square measure distribution at threshold worth in order that the SDN controller resists the DDoS attack programmatically.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of $2\times 4$ Planar Array Antenna with Beam Steering Facility
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper presents the design and simulation results of a 2 ×4 planar array antenna with effective beam steering capabilities for 5.8 GHz applications. The maximum gain developed by the 2 × 4 planar antenna array is 6.7664 dB. The simulated s11 parameter is -28.6290 dB using HFSS. The electromagnetic radiation pattern with angles of scanning range for beam steering of the antenna are simulated with MATLAB.

articleTitle: Hybrid Input Super Lift Luo Converter with Power Factor Correction Feature for LED Lighting Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In this paper, hybrid input super lift Luo converter (HISLLC) with power factor correction feature for Light Emitting Diode (LED) lighting applications is presented. The proposed converter operated on two modes viz. utility mode, photo voltaic (PV) mode. When the converter is operated on utility mode, power quality at the input side of the converter is improved. Hysteresis bang-bang type control is used for improving the power quality. When the proposed system is operated on PV mode, converter maintains constant voltage at the output side. The proposed system is designed and extensive simulation is carried out using the MATLAB/Simulink environment. Switching frequency of the proposed system is maintained at 100 KHz.

articleTitle: Optimal Power Flow in Wind Farm Microgrid Using Dynamic Programming
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Having an energy storage system for renewable energy results in power management of the microgrid. The storage equipment helps to match generation to consumption and thus providing energy balance throughout the system of microgrid. This work addresses the control of microgrid's energy by controlling the energy of the storage system. Energy from the renewable sources is stored for further use and by optimizing this stored energy we are able to optimize overall power supply to microgrid. This work proposes the application of an optimal power flow solution that considers the entire system: the storage device, voltages, currents and power limits.

articleTitle: Water Purification Using Solar Thermal and Solar PV
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: One of the most vital crisis faced by developing nations are the deficiency of proper drinking water storage system. Utilization or consumption of harsh water prompts medical issues. Thus, a water decontamination (purification) framework is developed, utilizing a hybrid solar thermal and PV. The solar still is utilized for the distillation of water during the peak solar hours. The water evaporates, condenses and gets collected in the collector compartment of the solar still. Moreover, the battery is charged utilizing the solar PV. As the sun's radiation diminishes, battery supplies the essential measure of heat relatively.

articleTitle: Demand Side Management and Voltage Regulation in Microgrid Using Electric Spring
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In the 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century, most of the countries going to decarbonize power generation to develop a sustainable environment. Consequently, the share of generation from renewable sources has been increased. Electric spring can efficiently be implemented in both commercial and residential buildings to stabilize the voltage fluctuations fed by an irregular renewable energy source. It can be installed in noncritical loads such as HVAC, electric water heater and thermal energy storage to provide instantaneous constant voltage support to critical load to follow power generation profile. Electric spring can operate in inductive as well as capacitive mode to significantly minimize the demand management side issues in the distributed renewable energy powered grid.

articleTitle: Optimal Placement of PMUs and Phasor Estimation Using OPAL-RT Real-Time Simulator
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: At the substation, phasor measurement units (PMUs) used for different applications, like as to monitor the steady operating system and also to provide special protection system during abnormal condition. In this paper, a Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP)-optimization algorithm is taken for finding the minimum number of PMUs. For WSCC 9-bus network, the complete observability is obtained by placing minimum number of PMU; the voltage and branch currents of the indirectly observable buses are estimated. For analysis of power system network, transmission line equivalent π-model is considered and for synchronized measurements, global positioning system (GPS) is used. The optimal number of PMUs needed for full system observability using MILP algorithm is determined in the General Algebraic Modeling System (GAMS) environment. The phasor estimation is done using MATLAB simulink and results are verified on OPAL-RT simulator for real time performance.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction and Image Classification Using Particle Swarm Optimization by Evolving Rotation-Invariant Image Descriptors
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In the system proposed here an algorithm for feature extraction and classification of image by using particle swarm optimization (PSO) is implemented. The effective performance in detection or sorting tasks by training of a desired model depends mainly on the features, which has been used in the training phase. The objective of feature design is to briefly define a certain features and key points which are needed to locate or classify required images. An area expert has been performing the feature detection or extraction since now, which in majority of the cases are costly and difficult to utilize and to discover. To automate these process image descriptors has been emerged by particle swarm optimization and to determine the measurement lengthwise for the feature vector continuously using only minimal instances from each class. A group of facial feature classification datasets is being used, also the performance of this method will be evaluated.

articleTitle: A Self-Governing Wheelchair for Severely Disabled Patients in an Indoor Environment Utilizing EEG and Laser Technologies
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Loss of motion is a dynamic terminal disorder impacting the focal sensory system, causing loss of movement of the muscles resulting in lack limb movement. A similar loss of motion is the Paralysis. This disease makes the patient completely reliant on a specialist or an attendant for all his day to day needs which incorporate his movement as well. This paper is showing a non-invasive driving assistance system by an automated wheelchair, for individuals incapacitated from any type of paralyses such as Cervical spinal cord injuries (C1 to C7), Paraplegia, Hemiplegia, Quadriplegia, and Multiple Sclerosis. Here the patients' brain signals are captured using the EEG technique and are processed and amplified. These signals are then utilized to make a LASER mounted by the pan-tilt-mechanism, to move and project a dot ahead on the ground. The wheelchair is equipped with a low-cost depth camera (Microsoft Kinect sensor) which performs a calculation toward the laser pointed target, in view of the navigability outline or the traversability map. At that point, if the point is reachable, the wheelchair is made to take the way autonomously with no help or physical exertion towards the specified location. The projects unwavering quality is improved by consolidating EOG (Electrooculography) signals and an ultrasonic sensor, which prevents any kind of collision. This paper mainly focuses on providing an idea which can help the people suffering from MND (motor neuron disease) and paralysis to become independent and empowered.

articleTitle: PID Tracking Controller for Air-Breathing Hypersonic Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper proposes a tuned PID tracking controller for the linearized model of an Air-breathing Hypersonic Vehicle(AHV). The control intention is to track angle of attack, velocity, flight path angle and the pitch rate of the AHV. The inherent coupling between the propulsion system, the dynamics of the airframe as well as the presence of vehement flexibility effects are the main challenges for control design in this category of vehicles. This paper proposes a tuned PID controller for tracking the linearized model of AHV. The proposed approach takes the advantages of small perturbation analysis method to simplify the strong couplings and hence linearize the system. The gain values of PID controller is optimized using Practical Swarm Optimization (PSO) technique. The performance of the proposed controller is examined using simulation and the results demonstrate that the proposed controller achieves excellent tracking performance.

articleTitle: Anti Accident System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) is one of the wide spreading region, which contains expansive no of smart devices and savvy devices. So these keen devices can likewise be utilized as a part of cutting edge vehicle observing and following framework. The fast development of innovation and foundation has made our lives less demanding. Despite the fact that the appearance of innovation has expanded, there is no diminishment in rush hour gridlock risks and the street accidents happen as often as possible. It causes colossal death toll and property on account of heedlessness. Our system is intended for observing the vehicle and whose adjacent vehicles in a zone at ongoing and give security condition to the explorer. For every vehicle the separation from different vehicles will be appeared in the show board. The show, as well as we give a light hit to appear if there is a vehicle near it. In this manner the drivers can decide if there will some other vehicles adjacent to this vehicle. A speedometer can be utilized as a part of an auto alert application with the goal that unsafe driving can be distinguished. This can be utilized as a crash or rollover indicator of the vehicle amid and after a crash. With signals alternate vehicles (hindrance) can be perceived. The proposed framework contains Global Positioning System (GPS) and Global System for Mobile Communication (GSM) which is utilized for vehicle following and checking component and for communication. The GPS gives current area of the vehicle, GSM is utilized for sending ready message. Microcontroller is the fundamental part in this system. Here we are utilizing 8051 microcontroller alongside different modules like GSM, GPS, Fuel gauge, Speedometer. Our system is mainly intended to control or to prevent the accident.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Action Predictor from Video Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The proposed system is an action recognizer that can effectively predict the type of action being performed from video. Being trained on a set of categories of actions called KTH dataset the system can actually predict the actions in those categories with a significant accuracy. Benefitting from deep learning the system is completely extendable to predict higher range of actions through training on larger datasets like HMDB and UCF101. The system uses a three stream Convolutional network comprising of a spatial, temporal and a movement stream, instead of traditional neural networks, that takes care of the frame characteristics gracefully.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Automated Quantitative Feedback TheoryBased Robust Controller for Photovoltaic Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Robust controller design for photovoltaicconverters (PVC) has received considerable critical attention due to solar panels operated under uncertain environmental circumstances. This paper presents automated loop-shaping based robust controller design for PVC voltage regulation with the aid of quantitative feedback theory (QFT) using Genetic algorithm. The step by step design guidelines for the automated QFT (AQFT) robust controller is deliberated in detail. The proposed AQFT controller exhibits decreasing modular plot, descending phase response and nearer to the universal bound to replicate the controller ideal characteristics. Finally., benchmarking of the proposed controller with affine parameterization design method available in the literature is performed through simulations.

articleTitle: Design of Fractional Order Controllers for Conical Tank Process
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper discusses two fractional order controllers, Fractional Order Proportional Integral (FOPI) controller and Fractional Order Internal Model Controller (FOIMC) applied to a nonlinear system. Internal Model Control (IMC) was suitable for plants like conical tank, because it considers model uncertainty, disturbance rejection and desired performance. PID controller was common in the industry because of its simplicity in tuning and robustness. All the controller parameters of FOPI and FOIMC were tuned using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm. A tool called FOMCON was used for simulation of the controlled process. Set point tracking and regulatory responses were compared using various performance indices and time-domain parameters.

articleTitle: Design Of 5.9ppm/°C Piecewise Curve Rectified Start-Up Free Bandgap Voltage Reference in 180nm CMOS Process
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: A start-up free bandgap voltage reference using piecewise curve rectification method in reducing the temperature coefficient, thus obtaining a stable output voltage with respect to temperature, is proposed. It uses piecewise nonlinear curve rectified current and a crosscoupled gain stage bandgap reference. The use of crosscoupled gain stage BGR circuit leads to area and power consumption by eliminating external start-up circuit. The PTAT voltage generated from cross-coupled gain stage bandgap reference and curve rectified current generator, and CTAT voltage generated from diode-connected bipolar transistor adds to form output voltage of proposed BGR. Based on the proposed design, a BGR circuit with a TC of 5.9ppm/°C under 1.8 V input voltage is obtained, and it can vary across a temperature range of -50°C to 125°C. It can also withstand process variation as well as supply variation which are from 1.6 V to 2.3 V. The tool used is Cadence Virtuoso for schematic simulation and all the circuits are implemented in 180nm CMOS technology.

articleTitle: Cache Aware Dynamic Scheduler for Real Time Task in Multicore Processors
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: With the advent of SMT multicore (Simultaneous Multithreading) processors co-scheduling of jobs on the same core, thus sharing core resources like L1, L2 caches there results a per process performance degradation depending on process resource requirements and the resource contention induced byco-runners. The main constraint of real time schedulers is to meet task deadline. In this paper, we present a real time scheduling algorithm, Cache Aware Dynamic-Earliest Deadline First (CAD-EDF) for SMT multicore processors that ensures no deadline miss. To this end, the scheduler estimates the cache miss rate of each task and compares the cache miss and the slack time of each task with the task running in a core before assigning it to a core by which the deadline miss can be reduced. The performance of CAD-EDF scheduling algorithm has been implemented in LITMUS-RT kernel on a 64-bit Intel Xeon D-1548 processor with eight SMT cores and 16 logical processors. Experimental results on it shows that the proposed scheduler reduces the deadline miss and maximize the CPU utilization.

articleTitle: An Efficient Privacy Preserving Scheduling in VANET Using NS-2
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The potential growth in Mobile Ad-hoc Network triggered the Vehicular Ad-hoc network (VANET) for traffic security and efficiency on roads, because once deployed they could bring a new environment to drivers. Vehicular communication in real time environment makes privacy a real challenge, which might affect the large scale deployment of these problems. In many of the existing systems the master secrete is not properly secured and in case of large deployment of vane privacy become crucial since the number of nodes get increases. Thevanet entities are not always adaptable to hold the huge certificate burden faced in real time applicatios. However it is challenging to authenticate and schedule messages in vanet. So an ID based two layer TA clustered authentication scheme is proposed. Moreover the real time challenges in vanet scenario is simulated successfully, so that it reduces the certificate burden and enhance the safe keeping of master secrete.

articleTitle: Design of Terahertz Sensor for Glucose Monitoring Based on 2-D Photonic Crystal Pillar Array
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Optical biosensors replaces the conventional diagnostic ways as they are compatibly small in size, easy to design and have high sensitive towards the inputs. Photonic crystals are widely discussing and progressively improving type of optical biosensors. They are widely accepted method of bio sensing. It measures the change happen in the refractive index due to change in concentration of analyte. The variation is due to the difference in the molecular interaction. Glucose is one of the primary source of metabolic activities of the living organisms. It is basically a monosaccharide. It is important to maintain the level of glucose in the body. The terahertz waves fall in the region in between infrared and microwaves in electromagnetic spectrum. These waves can be used as source for various types of sensors. These sensors have wide range of application such as biomedical imaging, communication, safety and security, etc. Using 2 dimensional photonic crystal pillar array we have designed a glucose sensor using terahertz waves source. The designed sensor is capable of sensing different concentrations of glucose in blood as well as in glucose solution. The sensor can measure concentration of the analyte up to 120 mg/dL in the sample. THz frequency up to 2.5 THz has used in the study. CST Microwave studio is the platform used for the simulation of the work. The proposed model deals with the development of terahertz glucose sensor for blood glucose monitoring.

articleTitle: An Investigation on the Effect of LER on Threshold Voltage and On Current of SOI, Bulk and GAA FinFETs
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: A device level way to quantitatively assess the influence of Line Edge Roughness (LER) on different fin based structures is considered. We know FinFETs have high drive current and offer better control over leakage and short channel effects. The FinFET device parameters such as On-current, Off-current and threshold voltage are impressionable to structure of FinFET. Performance of the 3D FinFET structures affected by LER. LER is referred to as randomly varied edges or roughness in printed pattern edge. The effect of LER in some cases results in reduction of leakage current, but in some cases it worsened the device parameter. The brunt of random variation sources on the electrical characteristics of the devices are not easy to be discriminated from each other. Random dopant fluctuations (RDF), Metal Gate Granularity (MGG) and Line Edge Roughness (LER) are the severe random variations which enforce restraints on the FinFET. Here an investigation on the effect of LER on the threshold voltage and On-current of SOI, Bulk and GAA FinFET is proposed. A comparative study on different structures is also presented. All simulations are carried out in Silvaco Atlas TCAD.

articleTitle: PM Synchronous Motor Drive for Electric Vehicles by Using an Adaptive Controller
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In this paper, the adaptive control method is applied to a Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM). An Adaptive control which depends on the input-output feedback linearization for torque and speed control of the PMSM is developed. Through the feedback linearization, direct and quadratic current decoupling and controls are achieved. The torque becomes only proportional to the quadratic current and direct current is controlled to zero. The adaptive control is used to estimate the uncertain plant parameter variation and also it does not need any prior information of real parameter. With the help of simulation result, the adaptive control scheme is performed. From these result, it is clear that the proposed method obtains high dynamic performance like vector control.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Linear Phase Less Complex Sharp Transition Band Filter Using FRM Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Since there are different telecommunication standards, communication engineers main focus turns to design flexible radio system to handle different service. As the ways and means by which people need to communicate data, voice, video communication, broadband messaging, command and control communication, and emergency response communication are increases exponentially. MWCR support multiple channels of different communication standard. The most important unit in transceiver is digital front end. Mainly digital front end of MWCR Perform operation like channelization, sample rate conversion, digital down conversion, pulse shaping. Reconfigurable digital filters or filter bank are used to extrication of different bandwidth frequencies from a wide band input signal in receiver. Reconfigurable filter make the system flexible before invention of reconfigurable filters, separate filters are used to extract signal of different standards. The MWCR use reconfigurable digital filters to perform multi standard channelization. The realization of linear phase dynamically reconfigurable filter with sharp cutoff and low complexity is really a challenging task. Literature survey gives a brief description of different types of reconfigurable digital filter (RDF) design, after literature survey FRM technique is chosen as best method to give sharp transition band filter. Reconfigurability of FRM technique is obtained by altering interpolation factor (M) in same channel and with use of additional pair of masking filter in different channels. Comparison of prototype filter with Frequency response masking (FRM) based filter is performed using Matlab R2014b and it is implemented in Modelsim 10.4b and in XilinxISE design suite.

articleTitle: High Speed Current Mode Threshold Logic Gates
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Neurons are the basic building block of biological intelligence in human body. Threshold logic gates represents the mathematical model for artificial neuron. There are several ways in which a threshold logic gate can be implemented. This paper mainly focuses on implementing threshold logic gate in current modelogic. Current mode based design has mainly two parts differential part and sensor part. The delay of the threshold gate is caused due to activation time (differential part) and boosting time(sensor part). A new design, which uses tunnel MOS in current mode implementation, which focuses on differential part to reduce delay is presented. Tunnel MOS based design provide less delay compared to purely CMOS based current mode logic gate implementation. The proposed design is applied in simplest current mode threshold logic, differential current mode threshold logic and dual clock current mode threshold logic. Spice simulation results on different gates implemented using the proposed design outperforms consistently the existing implementations in delay.

articleTitle: Single Carrier PWM Scheme for Single Phase Nine Level Symmetrical Inverter for Renewable Energy Interfacing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper presents a symmetrical single-phase, nine-level, cascaded multilevel inverter. Building block of this cascaded multilevel inverter is configured on the basis of h-bridge inverter having two dc-link switches and two diodes linked to these switches. Proposed multilevel inverter is interfaced with PV module for Renewable Energy Stand Alone System. A single carrier PWM scheme is used for the proposed multilevel inverter. This PWM method based on phase opposition disposition carrier scheme. Through Matlab simulation work is carried out of the proposed topology.

articleTitle: Certificate Authentication Using Periocular Biometrics
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Attestation is the act of validating the certificate by authorized person or department or authority with their official seal and signature. Attestation is done to avoid the use of fake certificates. In the event of academic certificates attestation from State authorities, followed by Ministry of External Affairs attestation then the Embassy attestation are required This process is time consuming thus to overcome this problem we propose a novel method of Certificate Authentication. To ensure the authenticity of certificate, it is integrated with QR code containing encrypted Unique Periocular features of the person. This code will be scanned and compared with the features extracted from the scanned image of certificate holder.

articleTitle: RFID Based Chameleon Card for Tribals
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This task is primarily centered around another RFID card which can change its capacities as indicated by the client needs. The RFID card (unique), is given to the tribal individuals which can go about as ration card, medicinal services and education card. This card is fundamentally useful for tribal who are uneducated. By utilizing this card they can buy designated proportion from the ration shop. At the point when the client approaches the ration shop they handover the card to the proportion provider and he/she wipes the card. Then it demonstrates the rundown of current things and its amount. Subsequent to conveying the comparing sum is deducted from their record by barring all stipends given to them. In the medical center, when the card swiped by the specialist, at that point they get the historical backdrop of patient's rundown and can refresh the rundown. In the therapeutic shop, the card can be utilized for acquiring prescriptions according to their remittance. This card is likewise used to understudy's instructive offices, for example, their expense installment, books, uniform and so on. The legislature is given the RFID card to the tribal families at the season of enlistment and a settled measure of cash is stored in their record then they can pull back the cash according to their stipends.

articleTitle: Computation of Design Metrics in Online Arithmetic Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Online arithmetic implementation of digital signal processing hardware improves clock frequency and reduces in-put/output utilization, area and power at the cost of higher latency. Online constant coefficient multiplication requires adaptation of the conventional shift-and-add algorithm to make the implementation non-causal. This paper presents algorithms for computing key metrics for evaluating solutions of online multiple constant multi-plication (OMCM) problems - online delay and number of flipflops. As the OMCM problem is NP-complete, these metrics can also be used as constraints to obtain solutions to the OMCM prob-lem in polynomial time. Analysis of the impact of imposing online delay constraints shows reduction in maximum online delay at the expense of an increase in the number of adders required.

articleTitle: An Efficient WSN Based Laboratory Environmental Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This article proposes an enhanced model of environmental parameter monitoring system for experimental laboratories through intelligent sensing, processing and communication techniques. Air pollution and excess temperature conditions that are of general concern in chemical laboratories are monitored by this system. Considering the probability of parameter detection and processing power requirements, Libelium Waspmote smart sensor system is used, which are widely recommended for indoor and outdoor environmental monitoring. A Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is established in the laboratory by incorporating multiple sensor nodes and a centralized Meshlium gateway having 4G, Wi-Fi and Ethernet connectivity. The gateway hosts the processed data to a cloud platform for storage. In order to improve the process identification and system consistency, multi sensor data fusion using Kalman filter based on Variance based Sensor Data Fusion technique is implemented at the WSN gateway. The efficacy of the sensor fusion technique in providing the best and consistent process information is demonstrated in the context of laboratory environmental monitoring.

articleTitle: Noval Hybrid System Compressor Based Watermarking Scheme for Security of Multimedia Data
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Pace at which the technology evolves astonishes the world. As the technology grows, more and more data is created and there is a high need to secure these data. The copyright protection and the authentication of the data is a critical issue to be attended. This paper proposes a method for copyright protection and authentication of multimedia data such as digital images. This scheme uses image processing transforms, single value decomposition and compressing sensing measurements to achieve security of the multimedia data. In this scheme host medium is digital image and the generated watermark data have many different security layers from embedding factor, measurement matrix. The orthogonal matrices, wavelet basis matrix also provides security. This scheme offers protection against various standard watermarking attacks such as Gaussian filter attacks, Mean filter attacks, Median filter attacks, Sharpening, Rotation, Histogram. This scheme provides payload capacity, robustness and perceptibility.

articleTitle: Automatic Atmospheric CO2Analyzer
