publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Automatic Atmospheric CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> Analyser is an IOT-based project which is designed for measuring Atmospheric CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> using Sensors. The project is mainly focussed on evaluating the quality of air in multiple polluted areas. The device include a portable hardware with sensors. All the details collected by the hardware is send to the server. Every user can access the data with the help of an Android Application. This project is designed with a hardware module and Software module. Hardware module consist of Raspberry Pi, Sensors for detecting CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, GPS module etc. Hardware is portable and its location is recorded on server. In the same way, Atmospheric CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> measurements is evaluated by the corresponding sensors and saved to the database in the server. Data is refreshed in the frequent intervals. On Software side, the module consist of Android Mobile Application. Using this Application, User can track particular location of the hardware that we use and checks the status of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> presence in atmosphere. In existing system, there will be no portable Atmospheric CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> Analysing devices which are collectively placed in multiple locations and most of the existing system has only a hardware which is directly connected to a computer (like, smog test). Here our System is accessible for multiple users in any location with the help of our Android Application. Through this, they can monitor the current status of contaminated areas.

articleTitle: Demand Side Management in Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: India is a developing nation with growing energy demand. With the limitations in monetary resources, increasing the generation capacity should not be the only way to achieve this target. Demand Side Management (DSM) is one such viable solution to this problem. Management of power from the demand side is DSM. The recent trend to use distributed generation like Solar Photovoltaics and Wind turbines has led to increasing usage of Microgrids nowadays. DSM can be applied to such Microgrids for their better and optimal performance and thus manage power to reduce investment. The applications of different objectives of DSM to microgrid are discussed in this paper. One such microgrid is taken as a case study. Application of DSM to this case study is discussed. The techno-economic analysis of the proposed case study is verified with the load flow analysis employing Newton Trust Region Method and DSM indices.

articleTitle: Investigation of Dielectric Coating on Particle Movement in Single Phase Gas Insulated Bus Duct Under Sf6/Co2 Gas Mixture
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Sulphur hexafluoride (SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>) is frequently utilized protecting gas in electrical apparatus to date. Gas Insulated substations (GIS)/Gas Insulated Transmission lines(GITL)are broadly utilized as a part of the electrical power industry for distribution and transmission of electrical energy. SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> is known to be a greenhouse gas. Additionally, particles levitation is a serious threat for the safe and reliable operation of gas insulated systems. Blending SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> with different gases (CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) not only reduces greenhouse gas effect but also enhances GIS operation to overcome particle contamination condition. Dielectric coating of inner surface of the enclosure greatly reduces the movement of particle contaminants. This paper reports investigation of different dielectric coatings on inner surface of outer enclosure in GITL/GIB. The movement of metallic particles is observed in pure SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> and eco-accommodating gases like CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>-CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> Gas mixtures. This movement is observed with thin Alumina and Epoxy resin coatings. The dielectric coating impacts are more articulated as expanding the thickness for all proportions of the gas mixture.

Author Keywords: Epoxy Resin and Al2O3 coating materials

articleTitle: Minimizing Harmonics and Transformer Derating in Low Voltage Distribution Networks by DC Distribution
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The widespread use of power electronic loads which are nonlinear in nature has led to the injection of current and voltage harmonics in low voltage distribution system. As the distribution transformers have to meet the harmonic losses caused due to the nonlinear loads, their power handling capacity is decreased leading to the derating of transformers. This paper investigates the feasibility of reducing harmonic distortion and derating of transformers by employing a hybrid ac-dc distribution system, in which the dc loads are powered by dc supply through a three phase diode bridge rectifier. For this, an in-depth analysis of the harmonic distortions in the power supply of different domestic buildings is performed by real time measurement and the impact of these harmonics on the derating of transformer in a conventional distribution system is evaluated by simulation. The improvement in power quality by dc distribution is demonstrated by simulation and experimental validation.

articleTitle: Impact of Channel Engineering on Double Gate Junction Less Transistor for Improved Analog Performance
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In this paper, the impact of channel engineering is explored on the device performance of double gate junction-less transistor (JLT). A source side n-type (5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>) pocket is used to improve the electrostatic integrity of conventional JLT device. Proposed JLT device improves the transport of electron from source to channel region more efficiently due to sharp rise in electrostatic potential compared with conventional JLT. Moreover, a reduction in drain electric field is observed, which improves reliability of proposed structure compared with conventional JLT. Proposed JLT device with high-k (C-WP-HfO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) gate sidewall spacer shows significant improvement in the short channel effects compared with its conventional counterpart. C-WP-HfO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> structure also shows impressive improvements in analog performance metrics such as transconductance (g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>), output conductance (g<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ds</sub>) and unity gain cut-off frequency (f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</sub>) compared with conventional JLT with HfO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> spacers. Use of source side pocket also relaxes the requirement of high work function material for gate.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of Monthly Solar Radiations and Wind Speed Data
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Increase in electricity demand has motivated us to move towards renewable energy sources. These energy sources are available abundantly and can never be exhausted. Environmental impacts are much lower than those with conventional energy sources. Therefore, in this study, solar and wind data has been collected at Aurangabad, Maharashtra (Latitude: 19°52' 3.61" N - Longitude: 75°19' 23.99" E) for a period of one year and statistical analysis has been carried out. Solar radiation data has been recorded to estimate the level of radiations falling on the same location mentioned above, while the wind speed data has been recorded and analyzed using Weibull and Rayleigh distribution and the best fitting distribution of wind has been found out using goodness of fit tests.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Suffix Separation in Malayalam
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Malayalam is a highly agglutinated resource-poor language. A lot of words in Malayalam are formed by the repeated addition of suffixes into root forms of the words called stems. Such words are called compound words. Identifying root words from the compound words is a key challenge in the preprocessing of Malayalam text. The grammar rules in Malayalam known as sandhi rules play a vital role in the splitting and formation of compound words. In this paper, we have proposed a hybrid methodology for suffix separation in Malayalam compound words. The sandhi rule associated with each compound word is recognized through machine learning approach. And suffix separation is performed using a rule-based approach. Since a lot of rules are required for suffix separation in Malayalam, we have only considered `Agamasandhi' words for rule-based splitting. The proposed system provides better results and can be extended to prepare a complete suffix separation system for Malayalam.

articleTitle: Quick Cart: A Smart Cart System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Shopping at the mall is turning into daily activity in varied cities. A shopping precinct is that the place wherever customers return to get their daily mistreatment product and pay the bills for purchase product. There we are able to see the push at malls on holidays and weekends. Therefore, there's Associate in Nursing rising demand for fast and simple payment of bills. Once looking at a very supermarket customers are annoyed for locating the things to be purchased. To beat these issues we've designed a wise cart with a mobile application. The applying helps the shoppers to seek out the placement of the merchandise. Sensible Cart provides a centralized and automatic charge system mistreatment RFID. Every product within the shopping precinct are going to be given an RFID tag. Every go-cart is enforced with microcontroller, LCD, Associate in Nursing RFID reader. The merchandise info is going to be browse by an RFID reader and it's displayed in liquid crystal display that is interfaced to the controller. In the charge cabin, the whole bill is going to be transferred to a laptop by Bluetooth module. That promotes fast looking and simply pay with a none queuing method. It reduces labor efforts and will increase potency by minimizing errors. The applying promotes fast finding of the product that situated anyplace of the shopping precinct or supermarket.

articleTitle: Lexical Simplification of Complex Scientific Terms
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Lexical simplification is the task of replacing a complex term with its simpler alternatives. We propose a system to identify complex scientific terms in a sentence and replace them with simpler substitutes. The proposed system has 4 stages, namely Complex word identification, Substitution generation, Substitution selection and Substitution ranking. For complex word identification, we use Conditional Random Field (CRF) based model. To obtain correct substitute for the complex term, we apply several filtering methods on the simplification rules. Results show that the CRF based approach for complex word identification gives better accuracy and our substitution generation method out performs previous approaches.

articleTitle: Computer Generated Phase Hologram Using Hybrid IFTA-Adaptive Simulated Annealing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper exhibits the implementation of generation of computer generated phase-only holograms and thereby improving the diffraction efficiency. It is necessary to reconstruct a quality image for several imaging as well as security applications. This paper brings out the idea of combining the traditional phase-only hologram generation method along with a global optimization method. The holograms thus produced are processed through diffractive optical elements with high diffraction efficiency.

articleTitle: Helicopter Maneuverability Control Using Nichols Chart
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The three degree of freedom helicopter system is a laboratory sized helicopter model normally used as a benchmark example for a multivariable control system. The paper proposes the design of a robust controller for the position control of three degree of freedom flight dynamics of a freedom helicopter using the technique of Nichols chart (Quantitative Feedback theory). A robust controller and prefilter is designed for the pitch axis for achieving the frequency domain tracking criteria and robust stability conditions. Pertinent results have been achieved for the required stability and tracking criteria.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of High Voltage Inductive VoltageTransformer
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Paper presents design of inductive voltage transformer IVT and analysis of transient overvoltage distribution across high voltage winding. The main suspected reason of failure of IVT is its distribution of voltage when exposed to lightning surge produced by lightning impulse. Paper also includes analysis of electrical stress distribution considering shields and without shield over HV windings. The HV winding used in IVT is of layer type and divided into segments. Model of HV winding is developed and the results have been computed.

articleTitle: Reliable Multiplier Design with Adaptive Hold Logic for Aging Awareness
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In most of the digital signal processors, multiplier is used as a key component. So, the performance of the system depends on the throughput of the multiplier. Now a days, reliability is an important design concern in advanced technology nodes. Performance of the system is significantly affected by the aging of transistor and the system may fail due to delay problems in long term. The impact of aging getting higher with the scaling of transistor. One of the main cause for aging in transistor is Bi-as Temperature Instability (BTI). Due to this effect threshold voltage of the transistor increases over time and it reduces the multiplier speed. Over-design approaches can be used to reduce the aging effect, but these may cause power and area inefficiency. Fixed latency designs have high chance of timing violations. So, a multiplier with variable latency is used for reliable operation under BTI effects. An Adaptive Hold Logic (AHL) is used for the proper selection of cycle period and an Error Detection Correction Pulsed Latch (ECPL) is used for the detection of timing errors.

Author Keywords: Error Detection and Correction Pulsed Latch

articleTitle: Fiber Bragg Grating Sensor for the Determination of Static and Dynamic Strain
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: learning (artificial intelligence); photovoltaic power systems; traffic engineering computing; feature extraction; cryptography; distributed power generation; mobile robots; feedforward neural nets; control system synthesis; Internet of Things.

articleTitle: A Study of Interdependence of Patron's Characteristics and IRCTC E-Surfing Through Chi-Square Test Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: IRCTC is a common platform to book tickets and other commodities for travelling through Indian railways. Numbers of tickets are booked each day through the IRCTC portal by person with different characteristics. This study brings out the interdependence of patron's unique characteristics like age, gender, education level, family income and his/her frequency of visit at the portal. The chi-square test is performed for the 155 analyzed users to validate the null and valid hypotheses. The responses of the users were collected through 5 pointer questionnaires in form of online Google docs. Finally, age and education qualification of the user were verified to be the key demographic factor to influence the frequency of visit.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Modified SVM Technique for Three Level Converter for Stand Alone SEIG Based WECS
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The limitation of Self excited induction generator when used in Stand alone systems is poor voltage regulation during change in speed and load conditions. To improve the performance of the system the two level back to back converters are replaced with three level neutral clamped converter. Indirect vector control method is implemented for both load side converter(LSC) and Rotor Side Converter (RSC) to control the SASEIG system. In this paper, a novel space vector modulation method is proposed for rotor side converter(RSC) to regulate the voltage and reactive power required for the generator during speed and load changes. To improve the performance of the system the two level back to back converters are replaced with three level neutral clamped converter. proposed SEIG based WECS is simulated using MATLAB/SIMULINK.

articleTitle: A Study of 1 V Voltage Regulator from 1.6 V Supply Using 14-nm FinFET Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper presents the design of basic linear voltage regulator using 14-nm FinFET technology process. The regulator converts input supply of 1.6 V to the constant 1V output voltage. N-FinFET is used as a pass transistor in the design for maintaining stability of the circuit. It is observed that calculated load and line regulation is 24 μ V/mA and 3.75 μV/mV, respectively. The regulator operates at a maximum load current of 2 mA, consuming quiescent current of 22 μ A and having load capacitance of 8 pF. Power supply rejection ratio (PSRR) of -23 dB is achieved at 100 MHz at a load current of 2 mA. Finally, the obtained figure of merit (FOM) is 0.0443 ps.

articleTitle: Extraction of Relationship Between Characters in Narrative Summaries
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Distinguishing relationships between people plays a vital role in understanding of narratives. We can experience different kinds of relationships like family, friendship, hostility, romantic love, etc. We know that Narratives are rich reflections of such relationships. Also extraction of relationship between characters is more helpful in understanding the person's actions, goals and behavior. In actual case relationships between people changes over time. So considering the dynamic nature of relationships will provide a better understanding of narratives. Existing research on analysis of people's relationships in the text has been limited Two simple schemes that use traditional machine learning algorithms. Relevant to this context, this paper proposes a system for extracting interpersonal relationships using deep learning concept convolutional neural network (CNN). The proposed approach produces a better performance over the competitive baseline model.

articleTitle: Development of Moisture Meter for Copra
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In India about 70% people are living in rural areas and are still dependent on agriculture. In the year 2014-15, 1975.81 hectares of area is used for cultivating coconuts in India. One of the important issue with agriculture crop sector is, estimating the price of major crops (copra, cardamom, pepper etc.) based on its dryness. This is currently done purely based on the experience of the estimator. Price of the crop is depending on the dryness of the crop. But in majority cases the farmers dont get enough money for their crop because of this dryness issues. The farmers spending lot of time, energy and man power if the drying process is not stopped when the ideal moisture percentage (different for different crop) is reached. The challenge exists in most food crops that are dried for preservation or processing. This paper proposes a low cost solution to the above problem which is a cost effective multipurpose Portable Capacitative Digital Agro Moisture Meter it uses a novel technology to analyze the moisture content of various agricultural crops. Farmer can use this product to estimate the dryness of their agricultural crop and thereby they will get enough money for their cultivate.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of ST7580 Power Line Communication with Signal Wire Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper represents the performance analysis of power line communication IC using FSK communication. The test has been performed the commercially available ST7580PLM modem and low cost power line modem with signal wire technique over 1km power line which consists of different noises which are generated by switching devices and electrical appliances. In this paper, the performance is calculated by Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) versus Bit error rate (BER).

articleTitle: Workspace Analysis Of A 6-DOF 3-RRRS Parallel Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The design of a spatial parallel robot is governed by two factors: volume of the workspace and shape of the workspace. In this paper, we subject a 6-DOF 3RRRS parallel manipulator having symmetric link lengths, under research. The most commonly used method to solve robot kinematics based on the Denavit-Hartenberg (D-H) notation. Since its inverse kinematics involves complicated calculations and solutions, there has been a need to develop a new method which can meet the demands of real-time applications. Derived from the basis of screw theory, a new improved inverse kinematic approach, which improves the efficiency of the inverse kinematics, is used. Along with Paden-Kahan sub-problems, a new and improved subproblem is used to counter the aforementioned problems. In order to arrive at a robust design, the required volume is taken as input while all parameters relating to a manipulator design, such as the link lengths, the moving plate and base plate radius, the orientation, the home angle configuration are all treated as variables while computing the inverse kinematics. In each case, the corresponding geometric relationship between the parameters of the manipulators is established. The configuration which satisfies the user requirements as well as with the least amount of singularities is provided as the result.

articleTitle: Multithreaded Image Processing Using ReconOS on Reconfigurable Computing System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper presents the implementation of Particle filter based Object tracking using ReconOS on Reconfigurable Computing System. Multithreading can be used to improve the performance of complex Image processing algorithms, but their sequential execution is a barrier which can be tackled by the effective use of FPGAs. In order to accomplish the desired performance, an operating system, ReconOS is used on an ARM based CPU-FPGA hybrid platform. ReconOS extends communication and synchronization primitives of operating systems like mutexes, semaphores, condition variable and message boxes to reconfigurable hardware. ReconOS provides the advantage of mapping the particle filter algorithm into reconfigurable hardware and accessing the data from software threads. Thus providing improved performance, portability and unified appearance as well as transparency to the object tracking application.

articleTitle: Optimized Amphibious Robot Propagation with Remote Access
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Drowning has become the highest cause of unintentional death across the world accounting for 7% of all injury-related deaths. According to WHO nearly 3, 60,000 people die from drowning every year. Even people who are well versed with swimming are not spared from this threat. This includes fishermen, tourists and other victims who visit beaches, rivers or lakes for recreational purposes. Though well-versed swimmers can struggle for a while, if sufficient aid does not reach them at the required time it could be disastrous. Although coastal lines have lifeguards, they are not able to approach the drowning person immediately which results in a mishap. Drowning cases also occur at recreation parks and resort pools where children are the ones to be directly hit. So it has become necessary to find a solution to this life-threatening problem. This project aims at providing an autonomous solution to this problem.

articleTitle: Modular Logistic Function for Rijndael Encryption Key Transportation Matrix Traversal and Retrieval Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Today encryption has a big stake on its way to information technology and cyber space in terms of functionality and usage in vast area. The world around it has developed one of the best way of enveloping human intelligence. Encryption standards has been at its apex to encounter and indoctrinate the value of privacy and information security in past centuries. Considering the consequences of the existing divergence in the field of cryptology and cyber security, a valuable and additional layer to the cryptographic realm is proposed. The Modular Logistic function proposes a singular idea on covering up the key inside a matrix thus increasing the complexity and the extra layer that protects the key over the transmission on the network. Enveloping human intelligence in every field has its research progressing on certain aspect which will improve on a daily basis.

articleTitle: Intelligent Carrus Assistance
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Drowsiness and exhaustion are the major reasons responsible for auto-mobile drivers having reduced driver's abilities to control vehicle, natural reflex, recognition and perception. It is due to such diminishing vigilance level of driver that is being observed at night driving, causes accidents and pose severe threat to mankind and society. Inorder to understand the attention level of drivers, eye movement can be used. In drivers attention plays a significant potential to enhance driving safety. Here it presents a real time system for monitoring a driver's vigilance. Since human eyes contains much information about the driver's condition like gaze, attention level and fatigue, Eye tracking is used as one of the key technologies for future driver assistance systems. In this project, attempts have been made to create a real-time system to collect driver's eye gaze. It is based on a hardware system used for the real-time acquisition of drivers and the software implementation is for monitoring eyes that can avoid the accidents. By analyzing information regarding distance between obstacles in the passage way and the vehicle and driver's vigilance level, we can actively prevent vehicular accidents, thereby improving the driver safety as well as we can also provide an assistance in case drivers get distracted. Here it creates an inexpensive eye tracking based system to accurately detect if driver's eye is distracted or not. The system does not require any driver-dependent calibration or manual initialization and works in real time. In the recent trend incoperating driver assistance system to detect drowsiness and fatigue is of atmost importance.

articleTitle: Design, Simulation and Optimization of Metal Oxide Sensor for Ammonia Detection Using Nanowires
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The levels of toxic gases are increasing enormously in the atmosphere, thereby causing adverse effects on the health of all living beings. There are various toxic gases like ammonia, oxides of nitrogen etc., which have to be detected and eliminated even if present in minute concentrations. Metal oxide based sensors is a sought-after technology for various reasons. In this paper, we present a method of detecting ammonia gas using titanium oxide nanowire based gas sensor. The basic principle of operation was adsorption of gas on to the sensing substance. This happens only at elevated temperatures which are provided by a micro hotplate. The aim was to increase the sensitivity of the sensor and to reduce the power consumption. Surface resistance, which varies due to interactions of gas and oxide, was taken as a measure to calculate the concentration in the ambience of sensor. COMSOL multiphysics tool was used for the performance analysis of the sensor.

articleTitle: An Optimized Hetrojunction Dopingless TFET
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The concept of dopingless TFET (DL TFET) is an potential solution methodology against problems due to RDFs. However., the low ON-state current ( ION) is still a problem in physically doped TFET and it becomes severe for DL TFET due to the existence of barrier at the gap between source and gate electrodes. Alternate solution against this problem is only heterojunction devices. These devices has got inherent high value subthreshold Swing (SS). This work focus on optimizing heterojunction dopingless TFET for obtaining low value SS. Methodology adopted is introducing a Metal Layer into oxide region between Source and Gate in DLTFET using Germanium and GaAs. Performance of various devices are r performance are compared. Optimized structure provides a ION in range of 0.1 μA, IOFF in the range of 0.39 fA and threshold voltage of about 0.7V is obtained.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Edge Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: An important aspect in the process of production is the difficulty to predict all possible problems or defects before initializing the product. It is necessary to have a continuous inspection process of products to ensure their qualities. In addition, some defects transcend the product quality issues. Many of the inspection processes of products, are still performed manually. The drawbacks of such human inspection is that it is time consuming and costlier. Moreover, the efficiency of human labor can be easily affected by environmental and personal factors. In this context, automated inspection processes are highly advantageous. In this work, a system to automatically identify edge defects in planar objects eg: Razor blades is implemented.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of MULE and SENMA Models for Strip-Based Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are group of low powered tiny sensors which have capability to sense different environmental data. The data sensed by the source nodes is forwarded to the base station via sink with minimal energy consumption and low communication cost. Recent approaches focuses on using Mobile Data Collectors (MDC) for data collection in WSNs to improve the lifetime of the network. MDC has two main advantages over the static sinks for data collection: (i) it can travel spatially separated geographical regions for data collection (ii) it requires minimal energy for its operation. Using MDC's there are two main models for data collection and they are: data mule (MULE), and sensor network with mobile access point (SENMA). MULE is an multi hop approach while SENMA is single-hop approach. The challenges for strip based network model is not addressed even though the basic architectures for MULE and SENMA have been well studied. This paper determines the average energy consumption of a node for strip based MDC through analytical approaches. The simulation results compares both the models for energy consumption and addresses the trade offs between energy and network sizes.

articleTitle: Translating Natural Language Sentences into Database Query
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The aim of this work is to transcribe natural language statements into logical forms, specifically SQL statements. The purpose of such conversion is to efficiently interact with the database. In this work, for sequence translation, an RNN auto-encoder is used which has been the foundation for several online translation between human languages. Decoder used is hierarchical RNN's, which has the ability to extract additional structure information from the special encodings in the training data inputs. This provides the decoder more information about the structure of the output that it can then correlate back to the inputs and generalize statements with the same logical form but with different specifics, such as locations, points of interest, time spans, or people. Evaluation is done on Geo-Query dataset and experimental results achieved good results.

articleTitle: A Study of 1.6 V Voltage Regulator from 2.5 V Supply Using 1.8 V Devices In 14-nm FinFET Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper presents the design of basic linear 1 V regulator using 14-nm FINFET technology process. The devices used in this circuit can operate at a maximum voltage of 1.8 V. N-FinFET is used as a pass transistor in this regulator. Regulator converts input supply of 2.5 V to constant 1.6 V output voltage. Miller compensation technique is employed in the design to ensure the stability of the regulator. Calculated results have shown load regulation is 0.9 μ V/mA and line regulation 0.14 μ V/mV. This regulator operates at a maximum load current of 50 mA. This design consuming a quiescent current of 32 μA only. The on-chip capacitance of 5 pF, the load capacitance of 10 pF used in the design. An obtained figure of merit (FOM) is 0.049 ps.

articleTitle: Design of Low Power 2–4 Mixed-Logic Decoder With Chip Enable
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Single logic style based decoder consumes more no of transistors, more power. Mixed logic design is alternative to this. Mixed logic style combines different logic style in one circuit. Hence a circuit gets advantage of different logic style.2-4 mixed decoder with enable offers low power compared to conventional CMOS logic style. Circuits are simulated using T-spice at 32nm technology node. Proposed decoder shows a 12% reduction in power.

articleTitle: Navigation of Mobile Robot in a Warehouse Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Path planning of a mobile robot based on occupancy grid map is discussed in this paper. The A star algorithm was modified to suit the warehouse environment. Optimal path is generated by revisiting the already traversed nodes if they lie in the shortest direction towards the target. The algorithm also monitors the battery health of the robot while planning a path. The algorithm was simulated in Matlab and also verified using a mobile robot.

articleTitle: A GaAs Based Metal-Interlayer- Semiconductor S/D Finfet
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The impact of MIS S/D Structure onthe performance of n-type germanium (Ge)FinFETs is evaluated using 3D SILVACO TCADsimulations. A new channel material such asgermanium (Ge) is used to continue the development of FinFETs by increasing the channel carrier mobility especially hole mobility. Due to device scaling, random dopant fluctuation(RDF)-induced variation in the channel region becomes intensified by diffusion from heavily doped source/drain (S/D) regions. In n-type Ge-based MOS devices, a relatively high S/Dcontact resistance is against implementing high-performance Ge CMOS technology below the 10-nm technology node. An ultrathin Metal-Interlayer-Semiconductor (MIS) S/D structure was proposed as a promising S/D contact structure, because it effectively lowers S/D contact resistivity in n-type Ge MOS devices than the Metal Semiconductor structure. The paper describes, the use of a MIS S/D structure which provides a new device the reduce to method design RDF effect significantly using the 3-D SILVACOTCAD tool. The work mainly focuses on the, SS with various spacer materials and substrate doping. For this a GaAs Metal-Interlayer Semiconductor structure with ZnO as the interlayer material structure is formed. Then the various, SS are compared by changing the spacer materials and by varying the substrate doping. The results are compared for Ge MIS and GaAs MIS structures.

articleTitle: Web App on Car Maintenance System on AIRBNB Concept
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Nowadays, the effect of modern technology is present in every field of life. Technologies ensures that the things that seemed impossible in the past are now done easily. The daily needs of human turns out to be digital according to demands of current online epoch. Developers try to deliver the best app that makes life comfortable. There are millions of web applications being launched every day. This application provides full access to the customer, with all the vehicle services in just one click. The customer can login with the credentials. The app provides various services for the customer's vehicle. If the customer intends to use different custom packages, the app provides the arena. The goal is to provide customer, the amenities for their vehicle. The customer logs in and provide the details of the vehicle. The vehicle details contain the information about the type and category of the vehicle. After the vehicle is chosen, they can move on to select the service that is needed for the vehicle. According to the service selected, the tariff for the current service is calculated. The tariff for the services varies according to the vehicle type and service type. Then the customer is directed to the payment gateway where the payment is done. Then the driver locates the customer and delivers the service.

articleTitle: Salient Structure Detection Using Depth-Wise Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: As the technology advances, the applications using images in computer vision is of greater importance. While encountering with information in images, saliency is a noticeable area. When observing some images, humans focus on particular areas or specific objects while other portion can be sometimes unnoticed. Advanced approach for salient structure detection is confered in this paper, by taking into consider the depth of images. The method includes adaptive thresholding in color spaces and then combining it with Hidden Markovian Random Field to acquire more efficient detection of salient structures.

articleTitle: Implementation of Hierarchical DFT Approach for Better Testability
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper presents an implementation of Hierarchical DFT approach to get better testability i.e. more test coverage at block level. The SOC is divided into number of Layout regions and layout as well as DFT regions as per the functionality requirement. The well-proven D-algorithm technique is considered for ATPG purpose. The Vectors are generated at the DF level inside the chip using Modus tool from Cadence at 16nm technology. For DFT region in the SOC, patterns are targeted for different test modes which includes both stuck-at and transition fault coverage. Each and every DFT region is targeted for Stuck-at and transition fault coverage of greater than 99% and 85% respectively. Before applying these patterns on the real silicon (chip) in the ATE (Automatic Test Equipment), they are validated by Simulation using IES from cadence at both block and device level. At block level the patterns are validated with and without timing constraints. The timing constrained simulation occurs by annotating the design netlist w.r.t. STA related timing reports, called as SDC constraints. Further, the block level DFT region pins are mapped to the corresponding device level pins. The patterns generated at block level being mapped to device level are again validated by logical simulation for the proper top mapping connections.

articleTitle: Office Automation for Digital India
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Automation Plays very eminent role in our lives. It makes the work easier and more simpler. With the increase in consumption of energy and population there is humungous need of energy conservation in the workplace. One of the aspects of maintaining a productive workplace is making sure that there are effective health, safety and security procedures in place. After all there is a humungous amount of hard work and capitals are invested then why not on the security? And here this office Automation System plays an important role. This system is based on sub systems lighting, security and alarming system. The major reason of energy loss is lack in functionality and inability to access the appliances from remote locations. An android application is used to monitor and control the workplace from remote location.

articleTitle: Conventional and Ontology Based Spam Filtering
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Emails are inevitable in this modern era. It has become an effective tool in the communication field. Because of its easiness the number of users are increasing day-by-day. With the increased number of email users, the number of spam mails have also increased. Spam can cause great loss to users. Many spam filtering techniques have been introduced to distinguish between ham and spam. A mail that appear as spam may appear as ham to another user and vice versa. That is, it depends on the personal preference of user. Therefore an ontology based personalized mail access is necessary. This paper compares the ontology based spam filtering and conventional spam filtering.

articleTitle: Optimization of Transportation Schedule
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Nowadays the public transportation of Kerala, i.e. the KSRTC is running under huge loss and to analyze the reason behind why such a loss is incurred. It is observed that many buses are plying in the roads without people. This is also causing more trouble and hence to find a solution, the aim was to properly model this system. It is also considering buses from two different locations and study how well the present transportation schedule works. Here the aim is to model this with all the parameters involved and make the equation as real as possible. Optimization and verification is done using available software tools.

articleTitle: Analysis of VOC Using Sensor Array for Early Detection of Breast Cancer
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Breast Cancer is the most common cause of cancer-related deaths among women worldwide. Early detection of the breast cancer can increase the survival rate. Studies show that women whose breast cancer is detected at an early stage have 93% or higher rate of survival in the first 5 years. The available diagnostic methods have limited accuracy in various scenarios. A good screening method is always supported by a report of reduced death rate after the implementation. In the present scenario, Mammography can be considered as best among the screening methods available. But the accuracy of the test is low in the case of women below the age of 50 as their breast has high mammary gland density. Recent research in the region of breast cancer detection found that Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs) in the human breath can be used as potential cancer diagnosing tool. This study makes use of the presence of these VOCs to create a non-invasive diagnostic tool with evidence reduced mortality rate upon implementation [1] [4] [9].

articleTitle: A Wearable Triple Band Button Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: A triple band button antenna for body centric applications is proposed in this paper. The three bands of operation are 2.4 GHz, 5.6 GHz for WLAN applications and 9.2 GHz for radar applications. The antenna exhibits omnidirectional radiation pattern in all the three bands. This antenna has a very small size compared to all the existing button antennas with a length, width and height of 23.7 mm, 23 mm and 3.18 mm respectively. It has a gain of 2.53 dB in 2.4 GHz band, 3.26 dB in 5.6 GHz band and 4.0 dB in 9.2 GHz. This antenna is a unique design in its size and bands of operation. The parameters like reflection coefficient, VSWR, radiation pattern etc. are simulated for achieving better results. With its overall miniaturized size it can be used as a cuff button antenna which can be easily fabricated in clothes.

articleTitle: Replacing Idioms Based on Their Figurative Usage
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Idioms are important part of everyday English. In one sense, idioms are defined as ambiguous if it has plausible meaning both in figurative and literal usage. It is difficult to understand its sense in figurative expression. Therefore, phrasal substitution for idiomatic expression in such special contexts has great applications, especially in NLP related fields. This approach identifies idioms in a sentence and recognizes idiom usage by incorporating some elements of context. Then identifies relevant replacement for figurative phrase by extracting knowledge from idioms dictionary definition and perform post editing to fit seamlessly to the original sentence.

articleTitle: Implementation of an Efficient Prosthetic Limb Controlled by Electro Myo Graphic(EMG) Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In this paper, we are discussing the concept, design, modeling, and prototype of a Myoelectric Prosthetic Arm, which uses the EMG signals from the patient for controlling the movements of the Prosthetic Arm. The electromyography sensor allows the user to measure the electrical activity of muscles. It is also used for controlling the prosthetic device. The signal acquired from the patient's body and after suitable processing, it is transmitted to Arduino, which uses the received muscle signal as an input to drive motors which are in turn coupled to the prosthetic arm. So, the amputee wore the arm initiate the control mechanism control. Though an amputee is dependent on the prosthetic arm, it is his/her myoelectric signals which run the arm, which is a confidence-boosting aspect of the myoelectric prosthetic arm.

articleTitle: Development and Implementation of an IP Core for Driver Assistance
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Today roads in developing countries like India has become a war zone in which thousands of people lost their lives and another thousand loss their organs as result of accidents. As a result of developments in technology, low cost but highly fuel efficient cars and bikes are being developed. Per capita income of people in such countries also rising rapidly. The new policies of banks also accelerate the rise in numbers of vehicles on the road. But the matter of concern is that the quality and capacity of roads remain the same as 20 or 30 years back. Majority of drivers are careless of road signs. This results in accidents and is harmful for both the passengers and pedestrians. In this work, an automated system for identifying the traffic signs for reducing the traffic accidents by alerting the drivers are developed. If an automated system for detection of traffic signs is incorporated with vehicles, it can alert the driver in advance about the signs and warnings to follow the relevant rules.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Network with Word Embedding Based Approach for Resume Classification
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Document Classification is a very prominent area, it is applicable for adiversity of novel applications. ln this study, we focussed on classifying resumes to different classes. The proposed approach is for classifying resumes using Convolutional Neural Network with Glove-Word Embedding. We have segmented resumes into various levels and a hierarchy of classification levels is created. For each level, the CNN with word embedding model is used for classification. The output of each classifier is later combined to define the overall hierarchy of the resume category. Results are evaluated using the performance measures such as precision, recall, and f-score. The results obtained are promising and the proposed system is helpful in the recruitment and selection process of candidates.

articleTitle: An Approach for Image Encryption / Decryption Based on Quaternion Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The image encryption or the secure image processing is an art of handling the image to provide protection from those image information theft or damage. It is necessary to maintain security for images such as medical, military, etc. So far many research work have been developed in the field of image information security and prevention. However the achieved level of security is not satisfactory, thus still this field is in research to find a better solution for the image data security and prevention. In this sense, this research is targeted to develop a better strategy for the image data prevention and security enhancement. There are many cryptography technique is available in the technical world, however this work adapted quaternion based approach for the image data security. Qua-ternion is a kind of number notation, it is the combination of both scalar and vector. Quaternion rotation is the concept applied in the image encryption for the security purpose. In the existing works authors have applied the Quaternion rotation based encryption of medical image and color images. In order to further enhance the performance of encryption, in this work the Quaternion Fourier Transform is applied. The Fourier transform based Quaternion rotation improves the performance in both security and computation. The proposed system is implemented using the working platform of MATLAB, and the performance is compared with the conventional quaternion technique. The proposed system provided better performance based on the comparative analysis with respect to correlation coefficient, avalanche effect, computational speed, normalized correlation and histogram.

articleTitle: Trust-Distrust Protocol for Secure Routing in Self-Organizing Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Now a days the usage of Self-Organizing Networks (SONs) is increasing, because of its wide application. Unlike common networks the SONs have the capability of reconfiguration, whenever any defect occurs in the network. Some of the SONs are Mobile Ad hoc Network (MANET), Wireless Sensor Network (WSN), Vehicular Ad hoc Network (VANET) and Wireless Mesh Network (WMN). In common nodes in these kinds of networks are mobile in nature, but these nodes can create new topology at the instant it shifts its position. However, in these networks the loss of data may occur while routing due to its security lack. Hence many researchers have presented their research for providing secure routing in various SONs. Hoverer the security is still an issue in routing of SONs especially MANET. In this paper, we have developed a novel protocol for the secure routing in SONs, which is termed as Trust-Distrust Protocol (TDP). As per the proposed protocol, the routing is done in four stages. In the initial stage topology management using an improved pillar k-means algorithm. The second stage is Link Quality Appraisal (LQA) based on the fitness of nodes. The third stage is grading, in which a grade point is allotted to every node based on LQA. In the last stage the secure path for the routing is determined based on the grade point. The proposed protocol is tested in one of the major kinds of SONs, like MANET using the MATLAB research tool. Ultimately the proposed protocol outperform the performance of the existing routing strategies.

articleTitle: Three Dimensional Space Vector Modulation for Three Phase Four Leg Inverters - A Review
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: This paper discusses three dimensional space vector modulation techniques (3DSVM) for three phase four leg inverters and its development over the past two decades. Three dimensional Space vector Modulation is the successor of conventional two dimensional space vector modulation (2DSVM), with an additional ability to deal unbalanced three phase system. An unbalanced three phase system demands a third dimension to represent zero sequence current in addition to conventional a and β frames. Here analysis of unbalanced three phase load system, types of three wire three phase systems, general methodology of 3DSVM, types of modulation techniques αβγ and abc coordinate system, and other new improved systems like gh γ system are discussed.

articleTitle: Hybrid Technique for Improving the Network Lifetime of Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: For Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs), the central challenge is improving the network lifetime as the sensor nodes energy constrained. The drainage of energy in WSN leads to entire network failure; therefore designing energy efficient communication model for WSN is demanded. There are multiple areas through which energy efficiency possible mainly routing protocol and MAC (Medium Access Control) protocols. In this paper, we contributed energy efficient solutions for both routing layer and MAC layer protocols. First we designed routing protocol which is mainly based on existing IECBR (Improved Energy Efficient Chain Based Routing). IECBR utilized the HBO technique for optimum node selection process. To improve performance of HBO based IECBR, we modified HBO approach with autonomous localization based eligible energetic selection algorithm which secure that nodes in the network are not remove of the energy for their threshold, as the load is shared with other nodes, when the energy of a node in the shortest path has arrive its threshold. Moreover, to enhance the energy efficiency, we modify the MAC protocol based on dynamic backoff algorithm called Improved Sensor MAC (IS-MAC). The contention window (CW) is dynamically adjusted in proposed MAC to handle the network load effectively so that energy efficiency achieved. The simulation results showed that, the efficiency of innovated solution in terms of network lifetime, energy consumption and throughput.

articleTitle: Secure and Efficient Key Sharing Scheme for MANET Using a Symmetric Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: MANET is a unique application in Ad hoc network which have no central coordinator or any central controller to manage the network. This network is formed automatically with wireless devices when demand arise for the routing the packets, without any prior infrastructure or base station. The main fact of the MANET is the mobility of the nodes and also the wide distribution and open medium makes them vulnerable to malicious attackers. In this paper, symmetric key approach is used between the trust users. This emerges the challenges in key management and also to overcome the existing key management due to unavailability and trustworthiness. A novel key management scheme is proposed which firmly shares the data along with the session keys between the users. This key management uses a self-configured protocol which helps to originate the network with secure services. The protocol uses lot of functionalities for initializing the node, route establishment and key sharing which is operated without the usage of external entities. Also, if any unauthorized members collude, they can't extract any confidential information during communication. Each and every node in a network is verified using digital signatures for authentication purpose. In order to Share the key, extra route packets are not needed. This paper lessens the usage of key pairs which limits the order of communication in the network. The proposed scheme also shrinks the cost of communication as well as limits the usage of resources.

articleTitle: Quad-Sec: Preserving Privacy of Data in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Nowadays, the use of multimedia data gets increased day by day. Thus we are in need of larger and larger storage for these data, but the client devices often fail. So, we depend on cloud storage, but new security challenges arises in which the privacy of user's data is compromised. In this paper, we propose a secure framework for outsourced privacy-preserving storage by introducing Quad-Sec; which enables secure data transfer, sharing and storage in the cloud while preserving privacy against cloud administrators and external hackers. The Quad-Sec is a file encryption scheme which performs double encryption on each file that is to be outsourced. 3-DES and AES are the two encryption techniques used. Low complexity and easy implementation make the proposed method widely applicable safeguard in the cloud computing.

articleTitle: DiGiConvNet - Enhanced ConvNet Digit Reader in Natural Scene Images
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the creation of machines that perform functions that require intelligence when performed by humans. AI is currently used in a variety of applications, such as in augmented reality, writing poetry, driving a car on a crowded street, diagnosing diseases etc. In image acquisition devices, an application of AI is the detection and recognition of text and digits in natural scene images. Recognizing natural scene image text is a very challenging area because of the large variability in appearance, with a lot of confusing backgrounds. Natural scene images are being increasingly used in areas like navigation and translation etc., making robust, accurate and fast digit/text recognition systems a necessity. This paper presents a novel DiGiConvNet architecture to read digits in Natural Scene Images. The DiGiConvNet has a unique parallel Convolutional Neural Network (ConvNet or CNN), trained on Maximally Stable Extremal Regions (MSER) image components enhanced using Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE). Good results have been obtained on the full natural scene test images of the Street View House Numbers (SVHN) dataset [18].

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Various LPWAN and Cellular Communication Technologies for IoT Based Smart Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The usage of Internet of Things (IoT) technology in device designing is increasing rapidly. Low Power Wide Area Networks (LPWAN) is popular and leading technology created for IoT networks. LPWAN is wireless based WAN technology that enables Low power consumption, long range, lower bandwidth with low bit rates. LoRa, sigfo x, NB-IoT, LTE-M are the leading low power, wide area network technologies useful for developing IoT networks. This paper presents a comprehensive study on various LPWAN technologies and comparative study between these technologies in terms of battery life time, cost, network coverage, latency, range and security. This paper e xpla ins all the merits and de-merits of the LPWAN technologies usage in real time scenarios and which technology fits best for each IoT smart applications.

articleTitle: A Technical Review on Control Strategies for Active Power Filters
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: The ever-increasing use of harmonic causing loads in the power system has led to the aggravation of many power quality issues mainly harmonics. The distortions triggered by these power quality issues must comply with the limits set by the international standard organizations. The mitigation of these problems is imperative and active power filters/active power quality conditioners are a practical solution to these issues. The control strategy plays a very significant role in the effective functioning of the APF. The control strategy also determines the performance, efficiency, stability, and reliability of the APF. This paper proposes a comprehensive review on the state-of-art control technologies of active filters highlighting their main features. Various control strategies are studied and investigated based on their characteristics, performance, applicability, and implementation.

articleTitle: Survey on Efficient Automated Toll System for License Plate Recognition Using Open CV
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Presently in nowadays an allowance of development on vehicle activity is observed. For the reason that is the manual checking and traffic management turns into a noteworthy issue. The fast increment in human populace had likewise requested an expansion in vehicles so the toll accumulation and tag acknowledgment for police is additionally troublesome. There be presents a result many different techniques on traffic management and surveillance are employed to reduce the complexities of the traffic man-agement. This proposed work is mainly used to outline and create in another proficient automated toll framework will be a decent minimal effort elective among the current frameworks. In this presented work a survey on automatic number plate recognition technique is presented. Additionally different methods and techniques are defined that helps to provide accurate estimation of the vehicles number plate recognition (VNPR). In addition of that a model for accurate NBR is also incorporated in this work, which is implemented in near future and their performance is evaluated. The proposed work is established on computer vision vehicle detection using Open CV Python in Embedded Linux platform. The work is designed by using Intel/AMD processor. In this camera catches picture of vehicles going through toll corner along these lines a vehicle recognized through camera. Depending on the tag of vehicle, grouping of light weight and overwhelming weight vehicles is finished. Further information is handed to DBMS, it is having web server set up on it and also it shows the information approximately the vehicle.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Wearable Antennas for Body Centric Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Body Centric Wireless Communication (BCWC) is an emerging area where communication is possible with the aid of wearable antennas. It is a short or medium range communication system having application in various fields like medical, military, defense, sports, location tracking etc. Body Centric Wi-Fi network includes several sensors located inside and outside the human frame. In these networks, in-body, on-body and off-body communication is possible. Wearable antenna plays a very important role in BCWC. The performance of wearable antenna is a crucial one and can be specified in terms of antenna parameters like return loss, impedance bandwidth, Polarization, Gain, SAR etc. This paper goal is to provide a review on performance comparison of various antenna designs proposed for Body Centric Wireless Communication.

articleTitle: An Survey on DNA Based Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Information Security play a vital issue in today's life. In this paper DNA is used as an information carrier. DNA cryptography is an upcoming technology, which combines biological information and data security. They provide wide range of extraordinary parallelism, exceptional energy efficiency, storing and computing capabilities. This paper presents a review on DNA Cryptographic approaches, highlights the merits and demerits of each one.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of a NAND Gate and a 2-Bit Magnitude Comparator Using GDI Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In this paper, an analysis of basic NAND gate using various CMOS techniques are discussed. These techniques include Pass Transistor Logic(PTL), Transmission Gate(TG), Domino Logic and Gate Diffusion Input(GDI). From these, GDI technique consumes less power. The power, delay and power delay product (PDP) are calculated. Later, using this low power GDI technique a Magnitude Comparator with 2-bit is compared with a proposed comparator. The proposed comparator is obtained by solving the truth table, using K-Map (Karnaugh Map). Here, the number of transistors needed is few and therefore the power dissipation gets decreased. Also, power, delay and PDP are calculated. Simulations are performed using Mentor Graphics Pyxis Tool in 180nmtechnology.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Full-Bridge Inverter Based DVR and Semi-Z-Source Inverter Based DVR
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: There is always a necessity to protect the voltage sensitive industrial systems from Power Quality (PQ) issues to prevent the loss of product quality and revenue. Generally, custom power devices take the responsibility to mitigate these PQ problems, restore the voltage and thus maintain the PQ standards. Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR) is one among the custom power devices which offers an economical compensation of load voltage under abnormal supply voltage conditions. The voltage injected in series by the DVR compensates the load profile during PQ events; appropriate voltage injected by the DVR in series with supply protects the load and restores the voltage to pre-defined values. The required injected voltage is generated by the inverter circuit in the DVR system. The most commonly used DVR inverter is the full-bridge inverter which consists of four switches. The Semi-Z-Source (SZS) inverter based DVR which offers same injection capability with only two-switches is compared with the full-bridge inverter. The in-phase compensation technique is employed in both the DVRs for injecting required voltage into the grid. The efficiency, quality of the injected voltage and load voltage are studied. This paper presents simulation results in MATLAB/Simulink environment to validate thecomparison.

articleTitle: Comparison of Sleep Transistor Techniques in the Design of 8-Bit Vedic Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Multipliers are the key components of ALU units used in many functions like signal processing applications, Fourier transformation and digital filters. Vedic mathematics which provide simple mathematical approaches is found to attain increased speed and reduced power consumption as in comparison to conventional multiplier designs. Leakage power has become a serious issue in the microelectronic circuit design as the technology scales down to deep submicron process. Sleep transistor technique is a simple concept to mitigate the effect of leakage power which uses extra transistors to turn off power supplies in the logic circuit during standby mode. In this paper, 8 bit Vedic multiplier is designed using power gating and drain gating technique along with its different variations.

articleTitle: Comparison of Caching Policies in Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: We consider a server containing a finite number of files connected to multiple users through a shared link medium. Each user has a finite cache memory and follows certain cache policy. User requests follow Independent Reference Model(IRM) model. Request for a file is serviced locally on a cache hit. If the file is not present in the cache memory, the requests are forwarded to the server. The server consists of multiple request queue separately for each user unlike traditional single queue at the server. Users follow certain caching policy such as Random, FIFO, simple LRU and comparison between them is made for different cache memory sizes. We use average queuing delay of requests at the server as a performance metric for comparison. We introduce probabilistic Least Recently Used(p-LRU) cache policy which uses probability of a file in catalog being requested as a parameter for insertion policy and compare with other cache policies. We draw samples from Zipf distribution to define the popularity profile of each file in p-LRU implementation and performance comparison is made for different request pattern of users. Finally, we have related the hit rate averaged over all the users with average queuing delay for all the cache policies discussed.

articleTitle: Study on Image Fusion Techniques Applicable to Medical Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: In order to diagnose any disease accurately, medical practitioners require a complete set of data regarding anatomical and physiological information of the area of interest. Different medical imaging modalities are available, which gives either structural or functional information only. Image fusion is a suitable method to combine various multimodality medical images to form a single fused image with all relevant data. This paper gives a review and presents theoretical comparison on various image fusion techniques available for fusing the desirable multimodality medical images.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Various H-Bridge Inverter Topologies Employed in Cascaded Multi-Level Inverter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Emerging Trends and Innovations In Engineering And Technological Research (ICETIETR)
abstract: Analysis of various H-Bridge Inverter Topologies like traditional full H Bridge, Modified H Bridge, Series/Parallel network employed H Bridge, Developed H-Bridge, Modified Developed H Bridge employed in cascaded Multi-level inverter is detailed. Here the comparison is mainly based on the number of voltage levels at the output, number of input DC Sources, number of power semiconductor switches, a variety of blocking voltage across the power semiconductor switches, number of switches ON during all the modes of operation and finally total harmonic distortion. Here the number of DC sources, number of power semiconductor switches and a variety of blocking voltage across the power switches are dependent on the topologies, but the number of output voltage levels and total harmonic distortion depends on the modulation methods used in the inverter. The performance of various H Bridge topologies has been simulated using MATLAB/Simulink.
